instruction.text: Bringe die Wörter in die richtige Reihenfolge.

atoms.sound: What do you want to be?
I want to be an architect.
He wants to be a postman.
She wants to be a police officer.

instruction.text: Schreibe die fehlenden Wörter in die Lücken.

atoms.sound: What does Anna want to be?
She wants to be a designer.
What does Robert want to be?

atoms.a: Er möchte ein Künstler werden, weil er das Malen liebt.
atoms.b: He wants to be an artist ((because)) he loves to paint.
atoms.sound: He wants to be an artist because he loves to paint.
What does Patrick want to be?

atoms.a: Er möchte ein Tischler werden, weil er mit Holz arbeiten möchte.
atoms.b: He wants to be a carpenter because he wants to ((work)) with wood.
atoms.sound: He wants to be a carpenter because he wants to work with wood.
